source_en: Hmph. Thanks for the charming example, you fence-sitter.⏎I thought you'd give me a little more credit than that.⏎I have the willpower to swallow all that EXS down if I have to.
source_slot: Grazie dell'incantevole esemplificazione, signor Opportunismo.⏎Pensavo avessi un'opinione migliore di me. Ho la determinazione⏎necessaria per assorbire tutto quell'EXS, se ve ne sarà bisogno.

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: What do you think it is, an all-you-can-eat buffet?⏎All the willpower in the world isn't gonna cut it.

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: If you end up on the other side, you'll never make it back again.⏎I can't see anybody else go out like that. Come on, just stay here⏎and let me go take down that Aeon fella.
source_slot: Se finisci dall'altra parte, non riuscirai mai più a tornare.⏎Non permetterò mai più che accada a qualcuno. Dai su, resta qui.⏎Lascia che ci pensi io a questo Eterno.

source_en: Hilda
source_slot: Hilda

source_en: I've never much cared for this side of you, you know.⏎You're always ready to tell me how strong I am...⏎until it actually matters, and then you're suddenly the strongest.
source_slot: Non mi è mai piaciuto questo lato di te, sai? Sempre pronto⏎a elogiarmi per la mia forza... Ma quando serve davvero,⏎ecco che improvvisamente sei tu il più forte.

source_en: Hilda
source_slot: Hilda

source_en: Spare me any more of your fake compliments.⏎They're extremely annoying, and none of them will stop me from beating⏎you right here and showing you who's really strongest.

source_en: Hilda
source_slot: Hilda

source_en: I don't care if you're ready or not.⏎If you don't take this seriously, you're dead.⏎That's all there is to it.

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: Me? Strong? Don't be ridiculous. I'm not strong.⏎I'm a coward. I've survived because I'm good at being a coward.⏎If I were really strong... he'd still be here.

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: Still... You and I do have a lotta history. Getting a serious challenge⏎from you is actually pretty interesting. Okay then, one serious duel⏎before the end of the world. Let's make it special.

source_en: Hilda
source_slot: Hilda

source_en: There. Was that so hard? Now, this battle won't just prove who's the⏎strongest In-Birth in Amnesia, but in the entire world!⏎Isn't that thrilling?

source_en: Gordeau
source_slot: Gordeau

source_en: Oof... Sorry, Chaos, but I don't think I'm getting outta this one alive.⏎This is the worst enemy I could possibly think to make...
